title: a test option that runs one test alone or skips with no condition
how: ESLint selectors in test files: an { only: true } option of describe / it / test / suite, and skip: true or skip: 'a reason' (a literal, not a condition); test.only / test.skip are LJ/no-restricted-properties

explain.what: A test has the option { only: true }, or skip: true / skip: 'a reason' with no condition.
explain.why: With only, the runner runs that test and silently skips the rest; a skipped test checks nothing. The suite still looks green.
explain.fix: Fix the test, or delete it if it no longer applies. If it must skip on some machines, make skip a condition (for example the platform).

selectors.message: a committed { only: true }: the rest of the suite stops running
a skip with no condition: make skip a condition, or fix the test
